page_title: STU 1-0 MON | Stuttgart v B. Monchengladbach 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+3' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90+1' The resulting corner, taken by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach), comes to nothing.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Sven Jablonski signals.
85' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Joe Scally is replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
85' Lukas Ullrich will be replaced by Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) comes onto the pitch for Kevin Stoger.
84' Here is a change. Rocco Reitz is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
84' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
81' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
79' 1 - 0 Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
77' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
76' The attendance is 60000.
75' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
75' Substitution. Shuto Machino leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach).
74' Substitution. Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Tiago Tomas.
74' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Maximilian Mittelstadt.
71' A cross by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
67' B. Monchengladbach are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
64' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lazar Jovanovic (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Chris Fuhrich.
64' Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Atakan Karazor.
61' Flag goes up against Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
61' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
60' The corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is intercepted by the defence.
59' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Stuttgart are going to take it.
58' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
57' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
55' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
55' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
54' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
54' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for holding. Sven Jablonski signals a set piece.
51' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach).
50' A lofted cross from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
49' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
49' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to send the ball in.
48' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The resulting corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared by the defence.
45+4' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
45+2' Stuttgart quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
45+1' The resulting corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A cross from Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
40' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

37' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Alexander Nubel pulls off a brilliant save.
32' Stuttgart control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
31' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul during an attacking move.
27' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul after Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) hacks down one of his opponents.
25' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

25' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net but Alexander Nubel keeps it out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for B. Monchengladbach.
24' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
23' Alexander Nubel leaps to intercept the corner kick from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
23' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner.
21' Good team movement sets up Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.

19' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
17' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Moritz Nicolas.
14' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is substituted due to injury. Sebastian Hoeness gives a chance to Chris Fuhrich.

13' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Sven Jablonski blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
11' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
9' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

9' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) heads on.
4' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) makes a strong challenge and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
2' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.

1' This shall not pass! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Stuttgart will kick the game off.
Sven Jablonski will supervise the game today.
